## Services

- Smart contract development: Solidity contracts for tokens, staking, vesting, governance, presales, referrals, swaps, and protocol logic.
- Web3 dApp development: wallet-connected React applications, contract integration, APIs, indexers, and product interfaces.
- DeFi and token development: staking, presale, swap, token utility, rewards, and decentralized finance workflows.
- Solana development: Rust and Anchor programs with wallet-connected interfaces.
- Web3 solution architecture: scope, smart contract architecture, permissions, data flows, and launch planning.
- Security-minded engineering: trust boundaries, permissions, key management, and common vulnerability patterns. Independent audits are recommended for high-value production protocols.
